# SignedCouplingPlasticity

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The ability of memristive couplings to dynamically alter both the magnitude and sign of oscillator interactions during learning, enabling Hebbian-like or anti-Hebbian updates. Bridges neuromorphic learning rules with reconfigurable hardware, enabling cross-domain adaptive systems that combine topological and neural principles.
